snippet.title: Galactic Conflict Trailer (Real-Time Strategy Game for iPad/iPhone)
snippet.description:
Official Trailer of Galactic Conflict, our new RTS game for iPad and iPhone. Battle other players online or enjoy the single player campaign in this large-scale real-time strategy game explicitly developed for touch devices.

Release date is March 14, 2013. More info can be found at http://galactic.bitmen-studios.com.
Download from the AppStore at https://itunes.apple.com/app/galactic-conflict-rts/id494394854?ls=1&mt=8
